interaction: Pick a round on the wooden scoreboard and the painted numerals and team boards flip over like split-flap plates while the clock swings to kick-off; below, the sample ladder sorts by points, goal difference or form (rows glide into place), filters by division, and tapping a club shows its W/D/L form chips and next fixture; the registration form suggests a squad and sample fee from year of birth and ends in a demo toast.
notes: Fictional club, league and opponents; results, ladder, fixtures, fees and sponsor packages are samples. Sponsor boards are an honest 'Your business here' placeholder. Registration sends nothing.
